page.overview:
Who is Beam Beam?

Beam Beam was a female fathier who was born around 1 BBY. In 3 ABY, they were ridden by Vinis Karyvin and competed in a fixed fathier race for the Galactic Empire.

Beam Beam was born around 1 BBY and by 3 ABY they competed in fathier races held in the city of Canto Bight on the Outer Rim planet Cantonica. That year, the fathier was purchased by the Galactic Empire. An Imperial officer personally inspected Beam Beam and determined them to be a fine specimen. Beam Beam was then set up by the Imperial Security Bureau to win a fixed race that was sponsored by the Galactic Empire and held during the Canto Cup racing tournament on Cantonica. For the race, Beam Beam was ridden by Imperial officer and jockey Vinis Karyvin. The race was promoted on posters placed around the city Myrra on Karyvin's homeworld of Akiva prior to its start.

Kay Vess, a scoundrel and cantonica native, noticed the promotional posters while in Myrra and immediately assumed the race was going to be fixed so the Imperial jockey would win. She had her suspicion confirmed when she overheard two Imperial stormtroopers talking about the race near The Alcazar cantina in Myrra. She eventually stole a datacard from an Imperial officer in the cantina and was able to determine that Karyvin was an Imperial Lieutenant. Vess then bet on the outcome of the race at a holographic fathier-betting module located in The Alcazar and watched Beam Beam with through the betting console's hologram.

Beam Beam was a female fathier who had brown fur and black eyes. During the sponsored race, the fathier was 299 centimeters tall and weighed 915 kilograms. An Imperial officer who inspected Beam Beam considered the fathier to be a fine specimen.
